newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine conditions right for buyback - Fernandez.
newsitem.headline: Argentine conditions right for buyback - Fernandez.

text.p: Economy Minister Roque Fernandez, in an interview with Reuters, said the "conditions are right" for Argentina to buy back foreign debt for the first time.
"It is possible this year. The conditions are right. We cannot rule out that possibility," Fernandez said.
"While the decision is not taken there is a series of analyses that urge us to think about it seriously."
Brazil launched a buyback earlier this year in which investors were allowed to tender their par, discount or C bonds for a 30-year global bond issue.
Fernandez declined to speculate on how much debt Argentina would want to buy back.
"The conditions are becoming right to improve our debt profile," Fernandez said.

"That is to say, put ourselves in the position that allows us to rescue issues that don't interest the investor and which, because of that, are punished by the market with an interest differential." ((-- Gary Regenstreif, Buenos Aires newsroom, 541 318-0618))
